user_stories: as a user I want to see dispatcher always ON when /aic active
as a user I want current task and pipeline to be stable (no flicker)
as a user I want activity log to display entries
as a user I want every task to go through 5-phase workflow (Investigate→Plan→Implement→Doc→Closeout)
acceptance_criteria: Dispatcher status indicates ON/active when `/aic` is active
Task and pipeline list does not flicker or repeatedly disappear/reappear
Activity log lists historical and new actions/entries correctly
Task workflow state strictly transitions through: Investigate -> Planning -> Implementation -> Documentation -> Closeout
